question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH legislator_first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lt.state,
        l.gender,
        CAST(MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE))) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, l.gender
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        0 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 0) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 0) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        2 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 2) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 2) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        4 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 4) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 4) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        6 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 6) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 6) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        8 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 8) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 8) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.state,
        lft.gender,
        lft.first_term_year,
        10 as interval,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lft.id_bioguide
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST((lft.first_term_year + 10) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > CAST((lft.first_term_year + 10) || '-12-31' AS DATE)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        interval,
        CAST(SUM(is_retained) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as retention_rate
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval
),
min_retention AS (
    SELECT state, gender, MIN(retention_rate) as min_ret
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
female_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM min_retention
    WHERE gender = 'F' AND min_ret > 0
),
male_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM min_retention
    WHERE gender = 'M' AND min_ret > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT f.state
FROM female_states f
INNER JOIN male_states m ON f.state = m.state
ORDER BY f.state
